ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-sm);margin:0;padding:0;}header nav a{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);text-decoration:none;font-size:0.95rem;letter-spacing:0.03em;padding:0.4rem 0.2rem;}header nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}main{display:block;}section{padding:var(--space-lg) 0;}section:nth-of-type(even){background:var(--color-surface);}footer{background:var(--color-dark-bg);color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);padding:var(--space-md) 0;}footer .footer-name{font-family:var(--font-serif);font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-bottom:0.3rem;}footer p{margin:0.2rem solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:var(--space-sm);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem;}.card img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:var(--radius);display:block;}.grid{display:grid;gap:var(--space-md);grid-template-columns:1fr;}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--color-surface);}table caption{text-align:left;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.5rem;}th,td{text-align:left;padding:0.6rem 0.8rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border);}th{font-family:var(--font-serif);color:var(--color-text);}label{display:block;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.3rem;}input,textarea,select{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0.5rem 0.7rem;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;font-family:inherit;background:var(--color-surface);color:var(--color-text);}form .field{margin-bottom:var(--space-sm);}@media (max-width:600px){.container{padding:0 1rem;}header .container{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}header nav ul{flex-direction:column;gap:0.3rem;}.logo{font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;}section{padding:var(--space-md) 0;}}@media (min-width:601px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(14rem,1fr));}header nav ul{flex-direction:row;}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto;}}

pages.title: Hartwell & Finch Booksellers — Local Independent Bookshop
pages.html:
Hartwell & Finch Booksellers
  • About
  • Featured Books
  • Opening Hours
  • Visit Us

Hartwell & Finch Booksellers

A cozy independent bookshop in the heart of Brookfield, where every shelf has a story waiting to be found.

Browse Featured Books

Our Story

Founded in 1987 by siblings Eleanor Hartwell and Thomas Finch, Hartwell & Finch Booksellers began as a single cart of secondhand novels at the Brookfield farmers' market. Nearly four decades later, we're still family-run, still independent, and still obsessed with putting the right book into the right hands.

Today our creaky wooden floors hold everything from new literary fiction to battered first editions, a well-loved children's corner, and a reading nook with the best armchair in town. Stop by, stay a while, and let us help you find your next favorite read.

Featured Books This Month

The Lighthouse at Dusk

Maren Oduya

A quiet, atmospheric novel about a keeper's final summer on a remote island. Staff pick for fans of slow, beautiful prose.

$24.00

The Quiet Orchard

Lucas Bramwell

A family saga spanning three generations of apple farmers in rural Vermont. Winner of the 2023 Heartland Fiction Prize.

$19.50

Notes from a Small Kitchen

Priya Fenwick

Charming essays and recipes from a home cook who believes the best meals come from the smallest gardens.

$22.00

The Cartographer's Daughter

Imogen Castellane

A sweeping historical adventure following a young mapmaker across 18th-century Europe. Perfect for fans of intrigue and travel.

$26.00

Opening Hours

Hartwell & Finch weekly hours
DayHours
Monday10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Tuesday10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Wednesday10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Thursday10:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Friday10:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Saturday9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Sunday11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Open later on Thursdays and Fridays for our monthly author readings — check our community board in-store for upcoming events.

Visit Us

Find Our Shop

221 Willow Lane
Brookfield, MA 01880

Phone: (413) 555-0192
Email: hello@hartwellfinch.example

We're tucked between the Brookfield Bakery and the old clock tower, with free street parking available after 10:00 AM. Dogs, strollers, and curious wanderers are always welcome.
